question: Write httpLabel(code) as a switch that returns OK for 200, Created for 201, No Content for 204, Not Found for 404, Server Error for 500 and unknown for anything else. Print the label for 200, 204, 500 and 418.

Build the same status mapping as a lookup object called labels, then loop over the codes 200, 404, 500 and 418 and print each code with its label or unknown when the key is missing. Print one final line saying both approaches can drift apart.
Write dayName(index) as a switch that turns 0 into Sunday through 6 into Saturday and returns bad day for anything else. Print the names for 0, 3 and 6.

Build a tiny test-run state machine. Start in idle, then run a switch over the command list ['start', 'pass'] that moves the run to running and then to passed, and print the state after every command.

Write calculate(op, a, b) as a switch on op that adds, subtracts, multiplies and divides, and returns the string unknown operator for anything else. Print all four results including the unknown operator case.
Write describeToken(kind) as a switch that returns bearer token, basic token, cookie session and no token for anything else. Print the answer for bearer, cookie and digest.
Write quarterFor(month) as a switch where cases 1 to 3 return Q1, 4 to 6 return Q2, 7 to 9 return Q3 and 10 to 12 return Q4, with bad month as the default. Print the quarter for 1, 5, 11 and 13.

Write describeType(value) as a switch on typeof value with a case per typeof name and a default for anything unexpected. Run it over the values 'text', 42, true, null and an array, printing one line each.

Write daysInMonth(month, leap) as a switch over the month number that returns the right length, using 29 for February when leap is true, and bad month for numbers outside 1 to 12. Print the length for February leap and February not leap.
Write gradePoint(letter) as a switch that maps A to 4, B to 3, C to 2, D to 1 and F to 0, and returns the number -1 for any other letter. Print the points for A, C, F and X.
Predict the output: a switch is given the string '2' and has cases for the numbers 2 and 3 plus a default. Print the default message and then the result with the number 2 to show the difference.

Predict the output: a switch declares let doubled inside case 1 and a second case tries to read doubled without declaring it. Show the program and print the line that reads doubled after the case that declares it.

Write handleEvent(event) as a switch on event.type with a nested switch on event.action for a click action that opens or closes a panel and a key action that saves or ignores. Print the result for a click open and a key flush.

Write nextState(state, event) as a switch on event that returns running after start, passed or failed after finish depending on state, idle after reset, and the same state for anything else. Walk the steps start, finish, reset with a loop and print the state each time.

Write gradeBand(gpa) using switch with a condition of true, so you can compare ranges, returning excellent for 3.5 and up, good for 3 and up, ok for 2 and up and needs work below that. Print the band for 3.7 and 1.8.

Write fizzbuzzSwitch(n) as a switch on n % 15 with cases for 0 returning FizzBuzz, plus separate switches' worth of handling for multiples of 3 and 5. Keep it to one switch by switching on the string of the remainder, and print the labels for 3, 5 and 15.
Predict the output: a switch is given the number 0 and its first case is the empty string. Print what happens, then print the result for the string zero-length value so the two differ clearly.

Write flagLabel(flag) as a switch with a case for true, a case for false and a default for anything that is neither, using two nested switches so undefined and null reach the default. Print the label for true, false and undefined.

Write permissionsFor(role) as a switch returning the array of allowed actions for admin, editor, viewer and nobody, with nobody getting an empty array. Print each role with its actions joined by a comma.

Write formatMoney(cents, currency) as a switch on the currency code that divides by 100 for usd, does nothing for eur and throws the string unsupported for anything else. Print the two results for 1250 and 1250 euro.
Predict the output: a for loop over 1 to 3 has a switch on the number with a break inside each case. Print what the program prints and explain why the break leaves the switch but not the loop.

Write httpClass(code) as a switch on Math.floor(code / 100) that returns success for 2, redirect for 3, client error for 4, server error for 5 and unknown for anything else. Print the class for 200, 404 and 700.
Write quarterByName(name) as a switch on the first letter of a quarter name, mapping Q to quarter 1 to 4 by reading the number, and unknown for any other input. Print the quarter for Q1, Q4 and X9.

Write seasonFor(month) as a switch where cases 12, 1 and 2 return winter, 3 to 5 return spring, 6 to 8 return summer and 9 to 11 return autumn, with an unknown default. Print the season for 1, 7 and 13.

Build a command loop that reads from the array ['add 3', 'list', 'quit'] and uses a switch on the first word of each command to add a number to a total, print the total, or stop the loop. Print each line the loop produces.
Write speedLimit(zone) as a switch that returns 30 for slow, 50 for city, 70 for road and 130 for motorway, and unknown for anything else. Print the limits for slow, road and parking.
Write summariseLog(lines) that switches on each line's level of info, warn or error, counts them and prints the three counts plus a total. Use one switch inside the loop over the sample lines.

Write menu(order) as a switch that totals an order string like 'pizza 12' or 'salad 8', returns unknown item for anything it does not recognise, and ignores an empty string. Print the total for pizza, salad and sushi.
Predict the output: a switch is given null and has separate cases for null and undefined, each with its own message and a default. Print the message for null and for undefined.
Write retryPlan(attempt) as a switch on the attempt number that returns immediate for 1, waits 1s for 2, waits 5s for 3 and stops for 4 and above. Print the plan for 1, 2, 3 and 5.

Write letterCount(text) that switches on each character to count vowels in one case group and consonants in another, ignoring spaces with a third group. Print the counts for the sentence the quick brown fox.

Write roleLabel(user) as a switch on user.type that returns different labels for admin, member and guest, and unknown for a missing type. Print the labels for an admin, a guest and an object with no type.

Write factorFor(value) as a switch on the string length that returns none for 0, one for 1, many for 2 and a big pile for 3 or more. Run it over the strings '', 'x', 'xy' and 'xyz' and print one line each.

Predict the output: a switch on the string abc has cases for abc, ab and a with break after each, and a default. Show the switch and print what it returns, then print what it returns with the input ab.
Write fileTypeFor(extension) as a switch on the file extension without the dot that returns text, image, archive or unknown. Print the type for png, zip, md and exe.

Write stateFromResponse(response) with a switch that returns offline when ok is false and status is 0, forbidden for 401 or 403, missing for 404, too many requests for 429, server error for 500 and above, and ok otherwise. Print the answer for 0, 403, 429 and 204.
